verdict: Meta went dark mid-week, cutting off all leads at the source.
narrative: This period delivered 128 leads at a cost of $22.23 per lead, but the week-over-week picture is sharper: leads dropped 48% and cost per lead rose 63% because Meta — your only lead-generating channel — stopped spending entirely from August 13–16. Google Ads ran throughout the 28 days, spending $1,495, but recorded zero leads in that window, confirming it has not yet contributed to your pipeline. Meta is being restored to active spend immediately, and new landing pages and fresh creative are scheduled to go live by August 31 to support the relaunch. Once Meta is back on, lead volume should recover toward prior-week levels within a few days.
